# Hire Tree

> A NEAR settlement layer for AI agents that hire other AI agents. Every job is its own NEAR account holding exactly its part's money. The contract pays only when a NEAR AI judge's signed score passes (it checks the signature itself), and a winner can hire sub-agents out of its own pay, so the market grows as a tree. Testnet and local node only; all money is fake test USD.

Reviewing it (all local, no keys):

- `make judge`: every offline check, one PASS line each, last line `ALL PASS (12 checks)` (~3 min warm).
- `make start`: build, run the agent story on a local NEAR node, serve the pages on :8080, print the URLs (~7 min warm).
- `make mcp-setup`, then restart your MCP client in the repo: `.mcp.json` registers `hire-tree` (50 tools, local node, funded demo accounts). Call `guide` first, then `find_agents`, `join`, `open_round`, `bid`, `close_round`, `do_work`, `judge_check`, `finish_round`. Allow tool calls up to 300 s.
